description: A woman threads gold cord through a cracked porcelain elephant in a bamboo grove beside a small living elephant.
A man fishes from a diving board into a swimming pool filled with autumn leaves as a silver fish leaps above them.
A girl opens an accordion whose pleats form mountains with a cable car above a cobbled street.
Three adults wait in a laundrette where washing-machine windows contain planets and pebbles spill onto the floor.
A boy and an older man sit on a dune seesaw beside glass butterflies and a single brass butterfly.
An older woman holds an upside-down parasol releasing glowing jellyfish above a rice paddy.
A boy crawls into a gramophone horn containing a starry sky in an orchard where bells hang beneath red apples.
Two people dance on a giant stone hand above a windy coast, with shoes lying on the shore below.
A woman drives a green tractor across a patchwork quilt that forms fields in a rocky valley.
A watchmaker assembles a mechanical beetle with transparent wings while a giant beetle peers through his window.
A child stands among giant domino-shaped apartment buildings while a flowering branch holds one leaning building.
Two people lift an orange peel curtain in a foggy forest to reveal a bright citrus orchard.
An older woman combs grass growing on a sleeping lion beside a bedroom window.
A cyclist pauses under a giant shoelace strung between rooftops, with tiny lit rooms inside its raindrops.
Two older men play with tree-shaped chess pieces on floating ice in a bath beside a deer carrying towels.
A woman rolls back desert sand like a carpet, uncovering a blue tiled riverbed beside a turtle carrying a cup.
A family floats in a soap bubble through a library where leaves grow from books and a ladder stands unsupported.
A woman winds a dark ribbon from the sea horizon onto a spool, revealing sunrise beneath a midnight sky.
A girl offers a bowl of snow to a bending cactus wearing spectacles in a twilight greenhouse.
Two porters carry a giant walnut containing a lit bedroom up a grand staircase.
A swimmer dives from a pier into blue feathers while a bird-shaped reflection appears in a puddle below.
A man waters a sprouting brick in a giant nest on a water tower beside speckled eggs, one with a glowing window.
Two children hold a skipping rope around a floating planet in an observatory whose telescope points down toward a garden.
